comment: Room-2 contract fixtures (ceilings / taxonomy / quorum). Throwaway test key kid test-key-1 — see the mint script header. Signed families: a2_ceiling (the A2 extension), raise_ceiling (the step-up family incl. F5 substitution/cross-org/replay negatives). Condition-table families: ceiling_gate (§6.2, pure {stamp,ceiling} comparison), ceiling_mutation (§6.3, request→outcome). Non-signed families are input/expected rows, NOT JWTs — same precedent as Room-1's ask_authority tables.
contract: room2-ceilings-taxonomy-quorum.md @ d3cf7487 + Room2 v1.2 exposure validation amendment

a2_ceiling.comment: membership_assertion + v7.6 authority_version and ceiling claims. Alice is membership epoch 7; the founding admin is epoch 8. update/stale/conflict/new-lineage-regression vectors pin the two-counter ordering. exposure_256 is the accepted boundary; exposure_257 is a correctly signed producer-bug negative FED must refuse whole. role_acls remains bundle-body-only.

raise_ceiling.comment: The step-up attestation for a sensitive ceiling raise. purpose=raise_ceiling, aud=cortexkit-account:raise-ceiling, 300s TTL, account_id=acting admin. The consuming batch's S1 predicate enforces account_id==caller AND org==mutation-org in the jti-consuming transaction. valid is minted by ADMIN_X for ORG; the negatives are the substitution / cross-org / replay / expired holes single-use alone does not close.

exposure_preflight.comment: Room2 v1.2 rollout preflight applies the exact write validator to stored rows. No truncation, dedupe, normalization or rewrite occurs.

ceiling_gate.comment: Input rows {stamp, ceiling} → expected {decision, reason?}. decision is 'admit' or 'park'; a parked row names which predicate failed (contract §6.2). Ladder classes: 1 OBSERVE .. 5 PUBLISH_EXTERNAL.

vectors.name: flag_in_low_ladder_tool_still_parks
vectors.note: the escape F3/ALF closed: a FINANCIAL action hiding in an OBSERVE-ladder tool still parks on the flag

vectors.name: dual_flag_both_needed
vectors.note: tier + credential pass, financial fails → parks; conjunction requires ALL

vectors.name: taxonomy_skew_refuses
vectors.note: version mismatch refuses BEFORE any comparison — fail-closed, never coerce

ceiling_mutation.comment: Input {caller_role, caller_is_target, change, step_up?} → expected {outcome}. 'change' names the component move; a move INTO the sensitive surface (tier→5 or a flag ask→allowed) needs step_up. self=caller_is_target true.

vectors.name: self_lower_flag_ok
vectors.note: shrinking authority is always safe, no admin, no step-up

vectors.name: self_raise_refused
vectors.note: a member can never raise their own ceiling

vectors.name: admin_plain_raise_ok
vectors.note: tier 4 is not the sensitive surface, no step-up

vectors.name: admin_flag_raise_needs_stepup
vectors.note: a flag to allowed IS the sensitive surface — a credential grant must not be cheaper than tier 5

vectors.name: stepup_substituted_caller_refused
vectors.note: attestation account_id ADMIN_X != caller ADMIN_Y → S1 predicate refuses

vectors.name: stepup_cross_org_refused
vectors.note: attestation org OTHER_ORG != mutation org ORG

vectors.name: stepup_replayed_refused
vectors.note: jti already consumed by replay_first → UNIQUE index aborts the second batch

vectors.name: kick_reinvite_resets_to_default
vectors.note: re-invite mints a NEW grant row → DDL defaults → zero-code reset
